name: Nazareth

queries.query: Israel official cadastral parcel map GIS Nazareth parcel API gov.il
queries.result: Found the official GovMap public map, Survey of Israel materials describing cadastral block/parcel data and APIs, and the public Survey of Israel parcel FeatureServer. A bounded anonymous response was obtained from the national parcel layer.

queries.query: ישראל מפה קדסטרית חלקות נצרת GIS API gov.il
queries.result: Found official Hebrew Survey of Israel/GovMap documentation identifying the government map portal, Topocad cadastral platform, and the parcel layer. The parcel service metadata identifies Israeli New Grid (ITM), EPSG:2039, parcel fields, and national scope.

queries.query: خريطة قطع الأراضي الناصرة مسح الأراضي إسرائيل موقع رسمي
queries.result: No additional first-party Arabic cadastral API was identified; the same official Survey of Israel/GovMap parcel service was the usable public source.

registryBasis: No Nazareth-specific local registry custodian or municipal cadastral office was separately evidenced. The verified source is a national Survey of Israel parcel dataset, not a city registry.

sourceCandidate.name: Survey of Israel parcel layer via ArcGIS FeatureServer
sourceCandidate.publisher: Survey of Israel / מרכז למיפוי ישראל
sourceCandidate.crs: EPSG:2039 (Israeli New Grid / ITM); sample response reprojected to EPSG:4326
sourceCandidate.nativeIdentity: GushHelka composite block/parcel identity, e.g. 16574/23; OBJECTID and PARCEL_ID also exist but are not retained as the canonical sample identity

requests.outcome: HTTP 200. Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, fields, native CRS EPSG:2039, full extent, and service capabilities.
HTTP 200. Returned OBJECTIDs 11580, 11581, 11582 with exceededTransferLimit=true; this confirms bounded Nazareth-labelled records but is not a complete city extract.

A point-intersects query at the immutable WUP point returned an invalid outFields error, and a retry with outFields=* timed out after 25 seconds. This route failure was not treated as citywide absence.
HTTP 200. Returned three full polygon geometries and native attributes in temporary evidence; retained sample was reduced to one canonical id property per feature.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Israel-wide parcel layer published through the Survey of Israel ArcGIS service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The service metadata and three Nazareth-labelled parcel responses were verified; complete city coverage was not established.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Research verifies a public source and bounded geometry, but does not authorize adapter admission; a serial reviewer must independently qualify request construction, coverage, rate limits, and identity semantics.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
